d: Northern autumn constellation dominating the sky with the Great Square of Pegasus and landmark exoplanet 51 Pegasi.

hip-113963.x: Blue-white subgiant star anchoring the southwestern corner of the Great Square of Pegasus.

hip-113881.x: Pulsating red giant star marking the northwestern corner of the Great Square.

hip-1067.x: Blue-white pulsating variable subgiant marking the southeastern corner of the Great Square.

hip-107315.x: Orange supergiant star marking the muzzle of the winged horse, known for sudden flare events.

gaia-2835207319109249920.x: Sun-like star (50.5 ly) where astronomers discovered 51 Pegasi b (Dimidium) in 1995, the first exoplanet around a main-sequence star.

hip-112029.x: Slowly pulsating B-type dwarf star situated in the chest of Pegasus.

gaia-1887953690728237568.x: Binary system of a yellow giant and F-type main-sequence dwarf in the northern wing.
